<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name:       Team Directory
 * Description:       Team member post type, REST API endpoints, a directory block and a document settings panel.
 * Version:           1.0.0
 * Requires at least: 6.6
 * Requires PHP:      7.4
 * Author:            Team Directory Contributors
 * License:           GPL-2.0-or-later
 * License URI:       https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
 * Text Domain:       team-directory
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_VERSION', '1.0.0' );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH', plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );

require_once TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'includes/post-type.php';
require_once TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'includes/class-team-directory-rest-controller.php';

/**
 * Registers the REST routes.
 */
function team_directory_register_rest_routes() {
	$controller = new Team_Directory_REST_Controller();
	$controller->register_routes();
}
add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'team_directory_register_rest_routes' );

/**
 * Registers the block from its built block.json.
 */
function team_directory_register_block() {
	register_block_type( TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'build/list' );
}
add_action( 'init', 'team_directory_register_block' );

/**
 * Enqueues the document settings panel script on team_member edit screens.
 */
function team_directory_enqueue_editor_assets() {
	$screen = function_exists( 'get_current_screen' ) ? get_current_screen() : null;
	if ( ! $screen || 'team_member' !== $screen->post_type ) {
		return;
	}

	$asset_file = TEAM_DIRECTORY_PATH . 'build/sidebar/index.asset.php';
	if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$asset = include $asset_file;

	wp_enqueue_script(
		'team-directory-sidebar',
		TEAM_DIRECTORY_URL . 'build/sidebar/index.js',
		$asset['dependencies'],
		$asset['version'],
		true
	);
	wp_set_script_translations( 'team-directory-sidebar', 'team-directory' );
}
add_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'team_directory_enqueue_editor_assets' );

/**
 * Flushes rewrite rules on activation so the CPT permalinks work.
 */
function team_directory_activate() {
	team_directory_register_post_type();
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
register_activation_hook( __FILE__, 'team_directory_activate' );

/**
 * Flushes rewrite rules on deactivation.
 */
function team_directory_deactivate() {
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
register_deactivation_hook( __FILE__, 'team_directory_deactivate' );

<?php
/**
 * Post type, meta registration and shared query helper.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Registers the team_member post type.
 */
function team_directory_register_post_type() {
	$labels = array(
		'name'               => _x( 'Team Members', 'post type general name', 'team-directory' ),
		'singular_name'      => _x( 'Team Member', 'post type singular name', 'team-directory' ),
		'add_new_item'       => __( 'Add New Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'edit_item'          => __( 'Edit Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'new_item'           => __( 'New Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'view_item'          => __( 'View Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
		'search_items'       => __( 'Search Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
		'not_found'          => __( 'No team members found.', 'team-directory' ),
		'not_found_in_trash' => __( 'No team members found in Trash.', 'team-directory' ),
		'all_items'          => __( 'All Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
		'menu_name'          => __( 'Team', 'team-directory' ),
	);

	register_post_type(
		'team_member',
		array(
			'labels'       => $labels,
			'public'       => true,
			'show_in_rest' => true,
			'has_archive'  => true,
			'rewrite'      => array( 'slug' => 'team' ),
			'menu_icon'    => 'dashicons-groups',
			// custom-fields support is required for meta to appear in the REST response.
			'supports'     => array( 'title', 'editor', 'thumbnail', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields' ),
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'init', 'team_directory_register_post_type' );

/**
 * Auth callback for the plugin's meta keys.
 *
 * @param bool   $allowed  Whether the user can edit the meta.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key.
 * @param int    $post_id  Post ID.
 * @return bool
 */
function team_directory_meta_auth( $allowed, $meta_key, $post_id ) {
	return current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id );
}

/**
 * Registers the role and start_year post meta.
 */
function team_directory_register_meta() {
	register_post_meta(
		'team_member',
		'role',
		array(
			'type'              => 'string',
			'description'       => __( 'Role or job title of the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
			'single'            => true,
			'default'           => '',
			'show_in_rest'      => true,
			'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
			'auth_callback'     => 'team_directory_meta_auth',
		)
	);

	register_post_meta(
		'team_member',
		'start_year',
		array(
			'type'              => 'integer',
			'description'       => __( 'Year the team member started.', 'team-directory' ),
			'single'            => true,
			'default'           => 0,
			'show_in_rest'      => array(
				'schema' => array(
					'type'    => 'integer',
					'minimum' => 0,
					'maximum' => 9999,
				),
			),
			'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
			'auth_callback'     => 'team_directory_meta_auth',
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'init', 'team_directory_register_meta' );

/**
 * Queries published team members.
 *
 * @param string $role     Optional role to filter by. Empty for all.
 * @param int    $page     Page number (1-based).
 * @param int    $per_page Items per page.
 * @return WP_Query
 */
function team_directory_query_members( $role = '', $page = 1, $per_page = 10 ) {
	$args = array(
		'post_type'      => 'team_member',
		'post_status'    => 'publish',
		'posts_per_page' => max( 1, min( 50, (int) $per_page ) ),
		'paged'          => max( 1, (int) $page ),
		'orderby'        => 'title',
		'order'          => 'ASC',
	);

	if ( '' !== $role ) {
		// phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.SlowDBQuery.slow_db_query_meta_query -- Filtering by role is the feature.
		$args['meta_query'] = array(
			array(
				'key'   => 'role',
				'value' => $role,
			),
		);
	}

	return new WP_Query( $args );
}

<?php
/**
 * REST controller for team-directory/v1.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Handles the members REST routes.
 */
class Team_Directory_REST_Controller extends WP_REST_Controller {

	/**
	 * Constructor.
	 */
	public function __construct() {
		$this->namespace = 'team-directory/v1';
		$this->rest_base = 'members';
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the routes.
	 */
	public function register_routes() {
		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base,
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_items' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_items_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => $this->get_collection_params(),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base . '/(?P<id>\d+)/role',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::CREATABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_role' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'update_role_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'id'   => array(
							'description'       => __( 'Team member post ID.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'integer',
							'required'          => true,
							'minimum'           => 1,
							'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
							'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
						),
						'role' => array(
							'description'       => __( 'New role for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'string',
							'required'          => true,
							'maxLength'         => 100,
							'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_text_field',
							'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Collection query params.
	 *
	 * @return array
	 */
	public function get_collection_params() {
		return array(
			'role'     => array(
				'description'       => __( 'Limit results to members with this role.', 'team-directory' ),
				'type'              => 'string',

content.text:
I've written the Team Directory plugin to `./output/team-directory/`. As you asked, I didn't run `npm install` or a build, so none of it has been built or tested in WordPress yet.

**Files written:**
- `team-directory.php`: the main plugin file. It loads the other files, registers the REST routes and the block, and loads the settings panel script only when editing `team_member` posts.
- `includes/post-type.php`: the `team_member` post type, the `role` and `start_year` meta (both editable in REST and the editor, only by users who can edit the post), and a member query used by both the REST route and the block.
- `includes/class-team-directory-rest-controller.php`: the two routes.
  - `GET team-directory/v1/members` is public. It takes `role`, `page` and `per_page` (capped at 50), each with a type, sanitizing and validation. It has a JSON schema and sets the `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` headers.
  - `POST team-directory/v1/members/(?P<id>\d+)/role` requires the `edit_post` capability for that post. The nonce is checked by WordPress's standard REST login handling.
- `package.json`: uses `@wordpress/scripts`.
- `webpack.config.js`: keeps the default block build and adds the settings panel as a second entry.
- `src/list/block.json`, `index.js`, `edit.js`, `render.php`, `style.scss`: the `team-directory/list` block. The editor fetches members from the custom route with `apiFetch`, shows a Spinner while loading, and has a role SelectControl plus a "members to show" slider. The front end is rendered by `render.php`.
- `src/sidebar/index.js`: the `PluginDocumentSettingPanel` that edits `role` and `start_year` through `useEntityProp`.

**Decisions to check:**
- **Role filter options:** the dropdown builds its list of roles from the first 50 members. A role used only by members beyond the first 50 won't appear in the dropdown.
- **Front-end paging:** the block's front end shows only the first page of members. It has no pagination links.
- **Minimum WordPress version:** the plugin requires WordPress 6.6, because it imports the settings panel from `@wordpress/editor`, where it lives in current versions.
